name: Casavecchia di Pontelatone
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A DOC in the province of Caserta, in Campania, centered on Pontelatone and a handful of nearby communes. Its wine is named for the Casavecchia grape.
